operating_notes.text: Rights Issue II was subscribed 92.11%, cutting proceeds to ₹459.59 Cr from ₹499.09 Cr and reducing the bank-margin object to ₹175.63 Cr.
₹2,061.5 Cr of receivables were outstanding over six months as at 31 March 2025, with reconciliation still under process per the FY25 audit report.
₹67.96 Cr Sri Lanka transmission contract (28km, 220kV double circuit, Lot B) won in JV with Fentons, 18-month completion, converted at 1 USD = ₹95.14 and 1 LKR = ₹0.29.
The Mannar–Mullikulam 220kV double circuit line is to evacuate power from the Mullikulam Wind Power Projects to Sri Lanka's national grid, executed in JV with Hayleys Fentons.
NCLAT allowed appeal against NCLT order on NFB limits, directing banks to respond within one month.
Mr. Deepak Dinkar Salunke appointed as CFO with effect from October 15, 2026.
Mr. Abdul Hameed Khan relinquished his position as CFO while continuing as Whole-time Director.
Awarded ₹689.93 Cr (excl. GST) turnkey contract from GETCO on 22 Oct 2026 for 765kV DC Pachchham - Saykha line, to execute in 42 months.

Received Notifications of Award from Power Grid Corporation of India for ±800 kV HVDC Bipole Barmer-II & South Kalamb Transmission Lines (Lot 1: ₹474.85 Cr, Lot 2: ₹474.50 Cr, Total: ₹949.35 Cr excl. GST) to be completed in 38 months.
Received Notification of Award from Power Grid for ±800 kV HVDC Bipole Barmer-II & South Kalamb Transmission Lines package TL05 valued at ₹648.91 Cr (excl. GST) over 38 months.

timeline.summary: Monitoring agency report for Q4FY26: ₹436.21 Cr of the ₹459.59 Cr Rights Issue II proceeds utilised, ₹23.49 Cr unutilised; board extended the objects' deadline to 31 March 2027.

2026-05-13: Jyoti Structures, in JV with Fentons, signed a ₹67.96 Cr contract with National Transmission Network Service Provider (Private) Limited for a 28km 220kV line in Sri Lanka, to be completed in 18 months.
2026-05-14: Press release recapping the JV contract with Hayleys Fentons for the Mannar–Mullikulam 220kV double circuit line in Sri Lanka, awarded by NTNSP; no value stated in the release.
NCLAT allowed the appeal regarding NFB limits on May 26, 2026, instructing appellant banks to respond within one month.
On May 29, 2026, Jyoti Structures announced the resignation of CEO Rajesh Kumar Singh.
Jyoti Structures reconstituted its leadership on October 15, 2026, naming Deepak Dinkar Salunke as CFO and Anil Jain as Non-Executive Additional Director.
Abdul Hameed Khan relinquished his position as CFO of Jyoti Structures on October 15, 2026, continuing as Whole-time Director.
Received ₹689.93 Cr Letter of Award from GETCO for turnkey 765kV DC Pachchham - Saykha Transmission line over 42 months.
Jyoti Structures bagged ₹949.35 Cr turnkey transmission line order from Power Grid Corporation of India over 38 months.
Jyoti Structures secured a ₹648.91 Cr turnkey HVDC transmission line order from Power Grid Corporation of India to be executed over 38 months.
